ledger_row_patches.reason: Exclude standalone paid-family-leave benefit administration. This amendment removes the employer requirement to exhaust two weeks of vacation before PFL benefits; it regulates leave/benefit sequencing, not residential access, work safety, contractor coverage, injury responsibility, tenant charges or account closeout. The prior selection rested solely on direct-employer status. Benefit exemptions and tenancy protections in other selected authorities remain intact.
